**New for Wayne County: TextMyGov**
Wayne County, NE is thrilled to introduce TextMyGov, a convenient and smart text messaging service! This service will enable residents to effortlessly receive important notifications about severe weather closings, events, etc. To enroll, complete the steps in the widget found on the lower right hand corner of the webpage or access more information at our TextMyGov page .
For ease of knowing that you will be receiving official notifications from Wayne County, a message containing a digital contact card will be sent to those who have opted in to our TextMyGov alert system. iPhone users: Create a New Contact. Android users: Download & import the contact info (a link for android users will be provided in the message). Also note: you can opt out of receiving messages at anytime.
Wayne County Register of Deeds Numerical Indexes are ONLINE ! Please visit the Register of Deeds page for more information.
